label: R6.2-DIFF-R2

definitions.EXACT_SCORE_MATCH: Both engines accept valid score-producing vector and compute numerically identical CVSS v4.0 score within absolute tolerance < 0.0001.
definitions.SCORE_MISMATCH: Both engines accept valid score-producing vector and emit scores, but numeric delta >= 0.0001.
definitions.VALIDITY_DISAGREEMENT: Exactly one implementation rejects an input formally classified as a valid score-producing vector by the eligibility manifest.
definitions.EXECUTION_ERROR: Unexpected runtime failure or unhandled exception not corresponding to expected validation behavior.

definitions.SYNTAX_REJECTION_CONCORDANCE: Both engines reject an input officially designated as negative/reference-invalid by FIRST, regardless of differences in specific exception class or message text.
definitions.NEGATIVE_VALIDITY_DISAGREEMENT: Exactly one implementation accepts an input officially designated as negative/reference-invalid while the other rejects it.
definitions.NEGATIVE_EXECUTION_ERROR: Unexpected non-domain runtime crash or exception outside the frozen expected validation exception contract.

first_reference_diagnostic.purpose: Identify whether primary, comparator, or neither matches the official FIRST reference score without altering the primary classification of the vector.
first_reference_diagnostic.official_score_source: FIRST reference score files (macro-scores, reference-scores, base-threat-scores)

derived_severity_concordance.applicable_subset: VALID_SCORE_VECTOR with valid scores from both engines

prior_observations_from_r1_acknowledged: 454,047 positive exact matches observed in R1
7,397 positive score mismatches observed in R1, all with |Delta| = 0.1
25,028 negative cases in reference-vectors with mutual rejection concordance
13,126 MissingMetric occurrences falling into generic exception in R1
observed association with cvss4py float-to-Decimal quantization in macro 2
safeguards: Zero tolerance widening to absorb 0.1 delta
No post-hoc exclusion of discordant vectors
No calibration or tuning of scoring engines
Null target and expected success rates

claim_boundary: Test Suite TEST-SUITE-R6-DIFFERENTIAL-CVSS40-R2 rigorously separates numeric float score concordance (D_numeric = 461,444) from negative syntax validation concordance (D_validation = 25,028) across independent CVSS v4.0 engines, maintaining strict post-result auditability under R6-DEV-005.
